_meta.purpose: BULK PLANET accretion seed - the undifferentiated ball at t=0. Core, mantle, crust, ocean and atmosphere are all PARTITIONS of this, produced by the sim. REPLACES abundance.json, which was a CRUSTAL assay (46% O / 5% Fe / no Mg lever) and therefore an OUTCOME used as an INPUT.
_meta.invariant: weights are mass-% of the REFERENCE planet mass (freq 96 = Earth, 5.972e24 kg) and sum to 100.0. Every element is explicit - there is no abundance_floor mechanism. The composition is size-invariant: a world born on a coarser grid is a SMALLER PLANET (the tile span is the canon), and World::seed sizes this total by size_scale^3 (R^3 ruling, 2026-08-06). Size is chosen by grid frequency, never by editing this file.
_meta.crust_is_an_output: The old abundance.json numbers survive as an ACCEPTANCE TEST: the crust the sim GROWS should assay near 46 O / 28 Si / 8 Al / 5 Fe. Never a seed.
